facts.text: Eat this arepa, mi vida, and that cut will heal. It is my gift, but honestly, the food is good all on its own.
facts.why: The transcript has no line like this. Julieta's real lines are about worry and love, and Mirabel is the one who says her hand was healed with an arepa con queso. The printed words are an invented quote.
facts.fix: Use a note: Eat up, mi vida. The arepas are warm, there is a seat for everyone, and nobody has to be perfect to sit down.

fix_note.text: Eat up, mi vida. The arepas are warm, there is a seat for everyone, and nobody has to be perfect to sit down.

vibe.verdict: A warm cafe with the right family in the right jobs, held back by one made-up quote and soft writing.
